Main Figure 2b–d pure PbTe NC-solid thermopower, conductivity and interpreted energy diagram; no direct film morphology.
Main Figure 3a TEM inset shows paper-synthesized Ag2Te NC input; other panels are optical and transport plots.
Main Figure 3b–d pure Ag2Te NC-solid thermopower, conductivity and interpreted energy diagram; no direct film morphology.
Main Figure 4 transport traces for the 1:100 Ag2Te:PbTe particle-ratio formulation; panel c is an interpretation, not a crystal image.
Main Figure 4 transport traces for the 1:10 Ag2Te:PbTe particle-ratio formulation; panel c is an interpretation, not a crystal image.
Main Figure 4 transport traces for the 1:1 Ag2Te:PbTe particle-ratio formulation; panel c is an interpretation, not a crystal image.
Main Table 1 thermopower, conductivity and activation energies for 1:100 Ag2Te:PbTe; no direct structural measurement.
Main Table 1 thermopower, conductivity and activation energies for 1:10 Ag2Te:PbTe; no direct structural measurement.
Main Table 1 thermopower, conductivity and activation energies for 1:1 Ag2Te:PbTe; no direct structural measurement.
SI Figure S1a,b as-synthesized external PbTe NC TEM and EDX; phase not determined.
SI Figure S1c,d paper-synthesized Ag2Te NC TEM and EDX; phase not determined.
SI Figure S2 SAXS before/after hydrazine for pure PbTe film; packing contrast, not atomic crystal phase.
SI Figure S2 SAXS before/after hydrazine for pure Ag2Te film; packing contrast, not atomic crystal phase.
SI Figure S2 mixed-film SAXS; caption and panel-code ratio disagree, so this is not bound to any exact main ratio.
Original symbolic Ag2Te synthesis and separate conductivity/thermopower film branches; not source figure pixels or measured structure.

SI Figure S1c exact-pixel TEM panel of monodisperse Ag2Te NCs in a monolayer assembly; 20 nm scale bar retained. Measured morphology image only, not atomic coordinates or a crystal-phase determination.

quality.review_scope: Independent scoped scientific audit accepted original main PDF pp.1–6 and matched SI pp.1–5: SI-original Ag2Te nanocrystal synthesis; externally prepared PbTe nanocrystal input; pure controls and Ag2Te:PbTe particle-number ratios 1:100, 1:10 and 1:1; cast and hydrazine-treated film branches, TEM/EDX, SAXS and transport outcomes. Main-only strict screening remains HOLD because it lacks the operational recipe; matched SI strict screening is PASS and supplies that route. Externally cited PbTe synthesis is excluded. SI Figure S2 mixed-film ratio remains unresolved, and no atomic phase is inferred from SAXS. ACS source-figure reuse permission is unverified.
missing_fields: PbTe NC precursor synthesis is cited to Urban et al. 2007 and is not reproduced in this paper.
Exact overnight reaction and hydrazine-treatment durations, film deposition cycle counts, NC mixture solution concentrations and hexane/octane ratio are not reported.
No crystallographic Ag2Te or PbTe phase refinement is supplied; SAXS assesses packing, not atomic phase.
Figure S2 mixed-film SAXS cannot be assigned to an exact Ag2Te:PbTe numeric ratio without resolving the caption/panel-code reversal.
conflicts: SI Figure S2 caption calls its mixed film a 10:1 Ag2Te/PbTe mixture, whereas panel code P10A1_M could suggest 10 PbTe:1 Ag2Te if expanded by chemical initials; the code is undefined. The ratio assignment remains unresolved.

Main p.1 calls measured films glassy/disordered; SI Figure S2 observes pure/mixed as-deposited SAXS peaks, but hydrazine-treated films lose those peaks. These describe distinct treatment states, not interchangeable structures.
Main Figure 4 caption typo 'PbT' in Ag2Te/PbT energy-diagram label is not treated as a different Pb-containing chemical.
Main Figure 3b caption describes thermopower versus inverse temperature, but the plotted x-axis is T (K). Preserve the caption/axis discrepancy rather than silently relabeling the data.

Main p.3 describes extracting PbTe E_s from the intercept of a thermopower-versus-inverse-temperature plot, while p.4 describes a slope; the source-internal derivation wording is inconsistent and is not resolved here.
Main Figures 2c and 3c print Eσ = 162.69 and 149.26 meV, respectively; main Results prose rounds these to 163 and 150 meV.
